issues.scope: unchanged repository baseline; non-blocking for this recipe
issues.description: The existing completeness checker treats a YAML block-scalar marker '|' as an empty value instead of reading its populated continuation lines. This caused the historical finish step5b failure for E219, E253 and E305. Their Git blobs are unchanged from the native-validation baseline.
issues.fix_suggestion: Track the parser correction separately; retain the actual finish exit 1 and the baseline blob evidence. No framework change is part of this recipe submission.

summary: Independent W4 passed for the frozen VTK 9.3.0 source submission: no P0/P1 found. Real native W3 rebuilt 9006 targets, ran all 1832 registered upstream entries with 1830 passed and two original Windows-backend skips, and passed the installed-package consumer checks. The historical outer finish exit 1 is retained and explained separately; completed submission readiness was rechecked.

audit.method: Read the official generated audit input and its rules; matched all 75 file contents to the reviewed commit and working copy; reused prior detailed source reviews of all 58 patches and reviewed the final runtime-resource/helper/consumer deltas. Independently recomputed returned hashes, recipe revisions, source comparisons, test counts and package identity. No new build, device action, or official result mutation.
audit.source_scope: VTK version directory and its paired E429 knowledge draft only; no framework/profile/rule changes, precompiled binaries, generated CMakeUserPresets, logs, or official state files in the committed diff.
audit.source_line_endings: All committed input files checked as LF.

source_and_test_review.verification: Both returned exports match the candidate code bytes; all export manifest MD5 entries and the derived recipe revisions match. Both sets of 58 compiled source hashes match the frozen intended source. The earlier in-memory patch application review matched all 58 patches to the official source archive.
source_and_test_review.substantive_tests: The recipe enables both VTK_BUILD_TESTING and BUILD_TESTING and runs full CTest without test-name filters. Failures propagate. Three installed-package programs exercise real VTK geometry, EGL/GLES rendering, texture/depth/state behavior, viewport handling and PROJ resources. Two negative controls require exactly exit 1.
source_and_test_review.runtime_resources: Private copies preserve prefix/lib and sibling share; resources are hash checked and atomically published. The empty Testing/Temporary landmark mirrors a real build-tree directory only and contains no copied test results. PROJ database header and EPSG:3978 initialization are checked by the consumer.
source_and_test_review.upstream_test_changes: Only UnitTestMath's plain-char expectation and TestLinearSelector3D's documented endpoint-exclusion parameter are changed. Original image baselines and image error thresholds are retained; expected geometry counts remain unchanged.
source_and_test_review.skips: AVIWriter and MP4Writer return the original VTK_SKIP_RETURN_CODE when their Windows-only backends are disabled; both remain in the 1832 denominator.
source_and_test_review.documentation: Final reports distinguish fresh W3, precompiled package preparation, historical failures, upstream cases and consumer assertion counts. No upload/published or remote PR-CI success is claimed.

package_prepare.scope: Standard export-pkg of the already compiled and fully tested tree; not counted as a fresh build.
